name: The Westin Michigan Avenue
positioning: Wellness-focused Westin in Chicago's Gold Coast district, on the quiet northern end of Michigan Avenue at the start of the Magnificent Mile, near the Lake Michigan shore
best_for: Shoppers who want the Magnificent Mile and Water Tower Place right outside the door
Runners and walkers who want the Lakefront Trail and Oak Street Beach nearby
Families, including those visiting American Girl Place

facts.text: The hotel is in the Gold Coast district, at the start of the Magnificent Mile.
The hotel is on the quiet northern end of Michigan Avenue.
The shops of the Magnificent Mile and Water Tower Place are right outside the hotel's door.
The hotel welcomed its first guest in 1963.
Rooms have marble bathrooms and the Heavenly Bed.
The Crown Suite is the hotel's highest level of suite.
The 24/7 WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio has Peloton bikes and TRX straps.
The Westin Run Club holds guided runs along the Lakefront Trail every Tuesday.
Dogs are welcome with a treat at check-in and a Heavenly Dog Bed in the room.
909 North has a scratch-made kitchen sourcing locally from family-owned Midwest farms.
With the hotel's American Girl Place partnership, a child's doll receives an American Girl Heavenly Bed, a designer robe and slippers.

highlights.text: Many rooms and suites offer panoramas of Lake Michigan, the Gold Coast district and the Oak Street and North Avenue Beaches.
The 18-mile Lakefront Trail is a couple of blocks from the hotel.
Oak Street Beach is a few blocks north of the hotel.
Body Rituals Boutique Day Spa is on the fourth floor and offers massages and wellness therapies.
Room design uses sand-hued palettes echoing the Lake Michigan beaches, splashes of blue and artwork of Chicago sights.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
A maximum of one dog per room is allowed, weighing 50 pounds or less.
WhataHotel notes a busy urban setting with typical city noise.
